customManagers.description: Flagsmith version used as the chart's appVersion, which is the default tag for the API, frontend and task processor images

packageRules.description: Commit message format the release-please changelog already uses, e.g. `deps: bump bitnamilegacy/pgbouncer from 1.16.0 to 1.24.1`. A package rule, so it takes precedence over Renovate's Docker defaults
Name the appVersion bump after Flagsmith, e.g. `deps: bump Flagsmith from 2.285.0 to 2.286.0`, since it covers the API, frontend and task processor images
Releases of third-party images must be 3 days old, so a compromised release is more likely to be caught before we ship it
Major bumps need a manual upgrade of the dev database
